facts.evidence: Never checked by the original composer (not among the 5 facts above). Independently verified 2026-10-21 in a fresh venv (pip install aspose-slides-foss 26.8.0): assigning an arbitrary nonexistent attribute to a Shape/AutoShape instance, a FillFormat instance, and a LineFormat instance each succeeded silently with no exception, and the assigned value read back correctly afterward -- reproduced across two separate fresh Python processes and, in the second, also confirmed for an underscore-prefixed attribute name (same silent-success behavior, no special-casing). `grep -rn "__setattr__|__slots__"` across the entire installed package tree (all .py files under aspose/slides_foss/) found zero matches: these are plain Python objects with an ordinary __dict__, so no code path exists that could raise AttributeError on an unknown attribute name. The README's claim is false; corrected in lane_l_candidate.md to state the true behavior (silent assignment, no validation or error, typo fails silently rather than being caught).
